name: classic-city-core/text-callout
title: Text Callout
description: A one-to-two sentence statement set large enough to stop a scroll. Renders a bare <div> wrapping the authored paragraph — no card, no background — so each child theme owns the look: style `p > strong` for a branded emphasis treatment, and use the div for ::before / ::after flourishes. Width is an ACF field (narrow / content / wide / full), and the block reserves spacing-60 above itself AND above whatever follows.
